## Findings
- claim-1: Task-owned artifact `c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d` (script SHA-256 `b7689eefc9b68455d47d84900619899ea47b0fc296b66414696f4c9167b08df0`) executed self-contained Python partition/horizontal-strip enumeration with exit status \(0\). Inputs were \(i,j=2,\ldots,6\), \(p,c=1,\ldots,5\), \(\min(p,c)=1\); captured output reports 225 parameter tuples, 900 checks of \(h_1x_0=x_1+y_1\), \(h_2x_0=\gamma+z+y_2\), \(h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z\), \(h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta\), and 25 doubly-boundary checks. It reports matrix \([[0,1,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,1]]\) on \([x_2,z,y_2]\), minor \([[1,1],[1,0]]\) on one-based rows \([1,2]\), columns \([z,y_2]\), determinant \(-1\), and `RESULT: PASS`. [artifact c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d]
- claim-2: Failed task-owned execution `cba25213fffc4bb931dfb264ddbc95dd73da45bc758cf5434d03adc6b383688f` had exit status \(1\), caused by selecting rows \([2,3]\) rather than the stated rows \([1,2]\) for the minor; it supplies no positive result. [artifact cba25213fffc4bb931dfb264ddbc95dd73da45bc758cf5434d03adc6b383688f]
## Strategy
Use task-owned artifact `c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d` (script SHA-256 `b7689eefc9b68455d47d84900619899ea47b0fc296b66414696f4c9167b08df0`). Its recorded self-contained executable enumerates partitions and horizontal strips for \(i,j=2,\ldots,6\), \(p,c=1,\ldots,5\), \(\min(p,c)=1\), with exit status \(0\). Captured output reports 225 tuples, 900 Pieri-identity checks, 25 doubly-boundary checks, and `RESULT: PASS`. It records the matrix
\[
\begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\1&1&0\\0&1&1\end{pmatrix}
\]
and certifies the minor on one-based rows \([1,2]\), columns \((z,y_2)\), with determinant \(-1\).

Thus the finite computation capability certificate is established.

## Gaps
The computation is finite and establishes no universal Pieri identity or parent theorem. It does not certify the previously stated rows \([2,3]\); those rows give a different minor.

Artifact `cba25213fffc4bb931dfb264ddbc95dd73da45bc758cf5434d03adc6b383688f` is unavailable in the supplied record and is not used.

## Next
Any universal claim or broader theorem requires separate proof or evidence.
